utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to be careful about the schedule and who’s bringing what. Once we have the pickup and drop-off details set, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Pia. Once the pickup and drop-off times are set, I can quietly let a few neighbors know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that would be great. Once we lock in the pickup and drop-off times, I’ll share the details more widely.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ve seen folks dropping off tools, blankets, and canned goods already. If I hear more about the timing, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — if you get the timing and pickup details, send them my way and I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass along any timing and pickup details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting underway—do you know if they still need more volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think they could still use both—I'll spread the word that volunteers are welcome, and if anyone has tools or basic repair supplies, that'd help too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules—I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along if I hear of anyone who can pitch in or needs help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll bring it up again and keep nudging folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping it on people’s radar. I’ll show up with what I can and help out once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep mentioning it so it doesn’t slip through the cracks. Appreciate you coming by and helping out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo — I’ve got the leaky faucet, the loose porch step, and the broken fence latch by the back gate noted. What time and where are we meeting for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for the repair drive—just point me to what needs fixing first. And yeah, keep me posted if the location changes; a quick update is perfect.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ve noted that. I’ll let you know if the location changes, and we can start with the leaky faucet first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — if you can lend a hand, the leaking faucet in the community room still needs attention after the railing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, who’s bringing the repair items, and is someone handling the drop-off too?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair items covered, and I can handle the drop-off too. Thanks, Kira — once the railing’s sorted, the faucet in the community room is next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: An hour at the corner lot works for me. I’ll be ready to head out with the repair stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the corner lot in an hour and help get the repair stuff loaded up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you then at the corner lot—I’ll be ready with the repair stuff.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 could work for me — I’ll check the school schedule and see if I can fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works for me, Faye. Let me know once you’ve checked the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check the school schedule and let you know as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Let’s meet by the corner lot in about an hour and head out together with the repair stuff. If I’m late, just give me a nudge—I’m a bit forgetful about the time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll keep the corner lot in mind and give you a nudge if you’re running late.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal—that’d help a lot. I’ll grab the repair stuff and see you at the corner lot in about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is still picking up nicely—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’m a bit scattered today, so I’m glad someone’s watching it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got tape and spare nails set aside, and I’ll keep an eye out for a screwdriver too. If Mara needs anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that’s really helpful. If you can bring the screwdriver, we should be set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring the screwdriver and the tape/nails I’ve set aside. Just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both you can borrow. I’ll bring them by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks — just drop them by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll swing by soon with the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up again and keep nudging folks so the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik—that would be a big help. If you can also ask people to share any broken items or repair skills they have, I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll ask folks to share any broken items and any repair skills they’ve got, and I’ll keep nudging people about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: An hour works for me—I’ll meet you by the corner lot and be ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that helps. I just want to confirm who’s handling the pickup and where everything should be dropped off so I can pass it along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can handle the pickup, and we’ll drop everything off at the repair shop by the corner lot. That should keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there and get started whenever you arrive. Thanks again for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli—I’ll pass that along and let you know if I hear of anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate it—just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m thinking we meet by the corner lot in about an hour, then head out together to drop off the repair stuff. If I’m a little late, just give me a nudge—I’ve got a habit of forgetting the time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that plan will work? Who’s bringing what, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that should work—I'll bring the tools and any small supplies I can find. If you can handle the bigger repair items, we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the broken fence by the corner lot, then I’ll check Mrs. Bell’s porch step.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a good start. Let me know if you need me to quietly pass along what supplies are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — please pass along any missing supplies when you can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep sharing that it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community hall, and people can bring broken small appliances or bikes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. If you hear anyone interested, just send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — I’ve got both you can borrow. I’ll bring them by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Gus — that’ll really help. See you when you bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You’re welcome, Mara — I’ll drop them off shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and spare nails set aside, and I’ll check for a screwdriver too. Anything else you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That should cover it, thanks. If you find a hammer too, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll look for a hammer too and set it aside if I find one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive spot and I’ll let you know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great, Opal — I’ll pass it along if I hear any timing updates too. Folks are still pitching in, so it’s looking pretty hopeful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll keep tracking the location and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good idea—thanks for keeping it on the radar.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll keep spreading the word and let you know if I hear from anyone who needs help. Hope we can get a nice turnout for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you keeping an eye out for anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help collect donations and sort them at the table this Saturday. Just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect, Sam — Saturday morning around 9 should work well. I’ll keep checking the school schedule and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there around 9 and ready to help with the donations and sorting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana—I’m still catching up, so extra tape, a screwdriver, or any spare nails would really help. I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—I’ll bring the tape, a screwdriver, and any spare nails I have.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana—I really appreciate it. I’ll head over as soon as I can and help out where I’m able.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
